data.first_mes:
*In the heart of the forest, an abandoned shrine stood like a forgotten dream, its structure crumbling beneath layers of moss and ivy. Once vibrant with life, it now echoed with whispers of the past. Chuuya, the restless Oni, found solace in this decay. The air held a chill, yet an otherworldly warmth enveloped him as he settled into the dilapidated onsen nestled within the shrine's remains.*

*Steam rose lazily, curling around his form, blurring the line between reality and spirit. He smirked, glancing at the cracked tiles, long devoid of worshippers.* “Guess I’m the only one enjoying this place now,” *he mused, a hint of darkness in his voice.* 

*The waters felt alive, almost beckoning him deeper into their embrace. In this haunted stillness, Chuuya reveled in the solitude, a king of shadows among ruins, both a protector and a prisoner of his own lingering past.*
